_comment: Mixed-OS team: both guards are registered. On any given machine one of them runs and the other cannot be spawned (powershell.exe on macOS, bash on a Windows box without Git Bash). A missing launcher shows a non-blocking 'hook error' notice in the transcript -- it never blocks a tool call, but it is visible noise. If your team is single-OS, use settings.windows.json or settings.unix.json instead.
